messages:
alex: FYI sales flagged a batch of integration asks — Python SDK tweaks, JS marketplace listing, Terraform provider changes, and SSO/SCIM for a couple of enterprise customers. Need triage + backlog tags. @anya @mike can you take a look?

jess: +1. Customers: Acme Health (PHI), FinCo (SOC2), and RetailCo (mid-market). Acme wants SCIM + SSO ASAP, FinCo cares about terraform + private registry, RetailCo wants a marketplace JS example.

alex: copying the raw asks so we have a single thread. Short bullets: 
- Acme Health: SCIM provisioning + IdP SSO (SAML/OIDC) + audit logging export.
- FinCo: terraform provider support for dedicated plan + examples for reserved capacity, tagging for cost centers.
- RetailCo: marketplace listing + JS SDK quickstart + sample app (cart chatbot).

alex: Proposed triage labels: [integration/sdk], [enterprise-sso], [terraform-provider], [marketplace-example], and priority hints [p0/p1/p2]. Thoughts?

anya: Agree on labels. Suggest also adding [customer-impact:high] for Acme and FinCo. For SCIM we need privacy sign-off (sec) and a scoped design doc.

mike: From runtime side: SSO/SCIM touches auth flows and onboarding. Need to confirm KMS/HSM requirements for audit logs and whether SCIM will be proxied through our control plane or implemented in-tenant for Private customers.

jess: Acme is on Private deployment with strict network controls; they asked for on-prem SCIM webhook endpoints (air-gapped). They’re willing to sign an enterprise contract.

oliver: Re: terraform — we should add provider resources for dedicated pools + a data source for current capacity. Also add examples for tagging: `redwood_resource "dedicated_pool" "acme" { tags = ["cost_center:acme", "env:prod"] }`.

alex: Good. For next steps I propose: 1) create intake tickets per customer ask; 2) label as discussed; 3) assign one owner from DevEx for SDK/marketplace, one from Eng-Platform for terraform, and Eng-Sec for SSO/SCIM review. I'll create tickets unless someone else wants to.

anya: I'll pick up SDK + marketplace spec. Will draft acceptance criteria: examples, CI-snippets, bundling guidance, and a small sample app repo. ETA: EOW for a first draft.

mike: I'll own SSO/SCIM feasibility + infra impact. Need a quick checklist:
```
- network model (private vs hosted)
- audit logging path + retention
- key management (KMS/HSM)
- SCIM delta sync cadence
- error/retry semantics
```
I'll post a short design stub by Tuesday.

jess: timeline note from Sales: Acme expects a pilot in 6 weeks, FinCo wants terraform examples before contract close (3 weeks), RetailCo is lower priority.

oliver: I'll draft the terraform provider issue and wire up an initial PR template for provider examples. Tagging recommendation: `integration/sdk`, `integration/terraform`, `customer:acme`, `customer:finco`, `impact:high`. Use `pq:customer-request` in the triage field so PMs can filter.

alex: Thanks. I'll create tickets now and add links here. If anyone has objections to priority labeling, say now.

devex-bot: Created issues: https://tracker.redwood/prod/INT-842 (Acme SSO/SCIM), https://tracker.redwood/prod/INT-843 (FinCo terraform provider), https://tracker.redwood/prod/INT-844 (RetailCo marketplace + JS sample).

alex: Great — linked. INT-842 -> labels: integration/sdk, enterprise-sso, customer:acme, impact:high, pq:customer-request. Assigned to mike, sec-review requested.

anya: Picking up INT-844. I'll create a repo stub and playground demo. Will include a JS quickstart + embed snippet for the marketplace listing.

mike: On INT-842 I'll set up a spike branch to test SCIM provisioning with an IdP mirror. Will also validate whether logs need to pass through our control plane for monitoring or remain in-customer.

jess: Thx team. Please keep Sales looped (cc @jess) on major decisions.

alex: Closing action items:
- anya: SDK/marketplace spec draft (EOW)
- mike: SSO/SCIM design stub (Tue) + spike
- oliver: terraform provider issue + PR template (this week)
- alex: confirm triage tags and add timeline notes to each issue

alex: If no objections I'll mark INT-843 as p0 for FinCo (sales pressure) and INT-842 as p0 too for Acme (PHI + pilot). RetailCo (INT-844) p2.

anya: Sounds right. :thumbsup:

mike: Fine by me. Will escalate any blockers.

devex-bot: Updated INT-842 status -> "triaged"; added label `sec-review`.
